verdict.rationale: Poke documents an inbound API that lets external services like GitHub or CI/CD send messages to Poke. That is the reverse direction of this story. Nothing in the evidence shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that would let a programmatic consumer subscribe to Poke events. MCP integrations and recipes are adjacent features, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
